question: If SINK is coded as 49 and CRAFT is coded as 43, then how will PRINT be coded?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26ecbf87c80fa04b2f1e136822c9e70b86a2ae36f54488347a6277cd9946f4f5.png] 

Here the logic is

**(Sum of the position of letters of word) - (Number of letters in the word)**

S = 19 

I = 9

N = 14

K = 11

Number of letters in the word = 4

= (19 + 9 + 14 + 11) - (4) = 53 - 4 = 49
